verdict.rationale: Zulip publishes REST API documentation at zulip.com/api, with endpoints such as Send a message. The docs are generated from a complete OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec shipped in the repository, and a versioned API changelog with feature levels supports client compatibility across server versions. The probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and an OpenAPI file at well-known web paths all returned 404, so the machine-readable spec is only reachable through GitHub. Missing for 10: an OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at a discoverable zulip.com URL, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The zulip/zulip repository ships a complete OpenAPI 3.0.1 description of the API, info title "Zulip REST API", at zerver/openapi/zulip.yaml.
The API feature levels system used in this changelog is designed to make it possible to write API clients... that work with a wide range of server versions
